bias.zh: 区间震荡 · 收复 100 日均线，受制于 30 日均线

read.en: SpaceX rose 1.3% on Nov 18 to $143.50, trading $141.22–146.30. It reclaimed the 100-day ($142.0, falling) and is above the rising 5-day ($140.3) and 10-day ($138.4), but below the 30-day ($145.2, falling); there is no 200-day yet (111 sessions). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram growing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($124.91), and RSI is 50.6.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月18日上涨 1.3%，收于 $143.50，盘中区间 $141.22–146.30。股价收复 100 日均线（$142.0，下行），位于上行的 5 日（$140.3）和 10 日均线（$138.4）上方，但低于 30 日均线（$145.2，下行）；上市仅 111 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$124.91），RSI 为 50.6。

read.en: The close cleared the 100-day and the $142.1–142.3 band (Nov 13 and 17 highs), now support, but the $146.30 high faded under the 30-day. Resistance is $144.9–146.3 (Nov 10–11 highs, 30-day, Nov 18 high), then $147.6–149.8 (Nov 12 and Aug 17 highs). Support is $141.2–142.3, then $138.4–140.3 (10-day, 5-day) and $135–135.4. A close above $146.3 would target $147.6–149.8; below $141.2, $138.4–140.3.

r.en: Nov 10 high $144.89; Nov 11 high $145.16; 30-day average $145.2; Nov 18 high $146.30

s.en: 100-day average $142.0, reclaimed; Nov 17 high $142.11; Nov 13 high $142.24; Nov 18 low $141.22
